description: Look up one company's CORPORATE insolvency notices (GET /search, 1 credit a call) in the sixteen insolvency markets FR, DE, GB, AT, CH, NO, FI, US, NL, DK, HR, SE, ES, LV, EE and SG, by company_number, siren/siret (France), vat or name; without country it searches every market your key may read. These are the notices of insolvency_notices_search (its description gives each market's scope and limits), one id per notice. Each row says where the notice comes from: source_type official_publication (ES, FR, CH, SG, DE, AT, NL, and GB notices from The Gazette), court_docket (US) or register_record (DK, SE, HR, LV, EE, FI, NO, and GB records from Companies House). court and case_number where the source states them (AT, ES, HR, LV, NL, SG, DE), published_date (ES, SG) and date_basis, what filing_date is (AT, EE, ES, SG); null means not stated. vat_number is built from the company number for ES, FR, SE, DK and CH (vat_number_source rule: the format is right, VAT registration is not confirmed), null elsewhere. event_type and status are the source's own: a notice can be the opening, a later phase or the end of a proceeding. Personal/consumer insolvency is never returned, and no notice is not proof of solvency. meta.attribution carries each source's credit (Contains CVR data (Erhvervsstyrelsen), CC BY 4.0, for Danish notices). Use insolvency_record for one notice.

company_number.description: Register number as the notice prints it (NIF for ES, SIREN for FR, Companies House number for GB, HRB with the register court for DE, ...); exact. Without country, every market whose numbers have that shape.

country.description: Insolvency market; omit to search every market your key may read. Not the same set as the company-registry countries.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor — pass the previous response's pagination.next_cursor, unchanged, to fetch the next page (a company name search issues o:<n>, the rows already served).

date_from.description: Filing date on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

date_to.description: Filing date on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

event_type.description: The source's notice type, e.g. insolvency, restructuring, liquidation, winding_up, administration, receivership, forced_sale (not every market has every type).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–100, default 20).

name.description: Company name, matched anywhere in the normalized name (min 2 characters); rows carry match_score. Ignored when a number or vat is given.

siren.description: French SIREN (9 digits); sets country FR.

siret.description: French SIRET (14 digits), read as its SIREN; sets country FR.

vat.description: VAT number of ES, FR, NO, FI, SE, DK, CH, HR or LV (e.g. ESB12345674), read as the register number the notices carry; it also sets the country. A value without a country prefix is read as a register number (a Spanish NIF such as B12345674). For other countries pass company_number.

name: insolvency_search
title: Insolvency notices of one company
